name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.7 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 8 visits over 75 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 41 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.1 days starting 2026-06-01, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
